correctness.evidence: Independent convex-hull/facet reconstruction and complete sign-cell set-cover recomputation reproduced 8,6,6,5,4 for the five displayed representatives. The original type-wide inference from affine invariance was invalid and has been removed.

originality.evidence: Broad searches of illumination, parallelohedron/Fedorov, and named-solid literature found general bounds and neighboring classes but no exact 8,6,6,5,4 table for these five explicit representatives.

value.evidence: Five exact classical benchmark polytopes with explicit upper witnesses and continuum-complete lower certificates provide reusable geometric test cases without overclaiming type-wide invariance.
